notes.title: Demo bug fixes are here!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for trying out the Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory Demo!

We appreciate your feedback and cooperation. With your help, we have been able to address and fix the reported bugs, particularly the issues with the Linux version.

We encourage you to continue sending any bug reports or feedback to support@differenttales.com if you encounter any issues. Your input is valuable to us as we strive to improve the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2463980/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Purgatory/
